posts.body:
Has anyone signed up to the 'My Mothercare' club and know what the vouchers are and how long it takes to receive them? My daughter needs a new car seat in the next month or so. I've just signed up and wondered if there might be a voucher that would give me money off the seat.

Thanks

posts.body:
Hi, we signed up and they weren't all that impressive. I think £5 off a £30 spend was the best thing, the others were mostly generic like £x off at a supermarket, probably for first time customer. Not sure if they vary.

Just checked my e-mail, here's what they offered;

£5 off £50 spend (online and in-store)

£10 off £100 spend (as above)

£20 off first shop at ocado (minimum £80 spend)

25% off flowers (Arena Flowers)

2 for 1 health and beauty treatments

Free USB stick worth £15 with a babybond 4D scan

upto 50% off mealsat 1000's of restaurants

everything else was even more generic and not worth mentioning. The first 2 could be handy with the sale on right now, I haven't looked but i believei t's mostly on clothes which doesn't really help (we have too many clothes for her!)

posts.body:
Babys'r'us are good for vouchers for car seats, sign up or pick up the instore booklet and there are some on the back page.

Also,may be worth mentioning that i'm currently looking into buying a car seat with mothercare, but i've not had any decent deals from them from being in the club ~ However, the magazine that Mothercare issue (called Gurgle) does have vouchers in that seem to be more worthwhile, but as it around £3 it's worth looking inside before you buy!

Hope this helps..
